# Ideation archive — the wide lesson-idea set, April 2026

**Superseded. Do not edit anything in this folder. Do not treat it as the current syllabus.**

This is the material that used to live in the separate `GWTH_curriculum` repo, which was
retired on 2026-09-18. It is kept because it is the only copy of the *wide* ideation set —
the ideas that were considered and then cut.

## Why it exists separately from the files one level up

`gwth_lesson_ideas/MONTH_1_LESSON_IDEAS_2026-04-20.md` (one level up, in this repo) is the
**current, narrowed** version — the syllabus as decided, last revised 2026-07-03.
`lesson-ideas/MONTH_1_LESSON_IDEAS_2026-04-20.md` (in here) is the **original wide version**
from 2026-04-23, which is larger because it still carries the material that was cut.

| Month | Current (one level up) | This archive | What only exists here |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 lessons, 15 builds, 70 KB | 22 lessons, 16 builds, 119 KB | Lab ideas from lessons not taught; optional lessons; "Why students enrol — the four journeys" |
| 2 | 78 KB | 85 KB | Cut material |
| 3 | 29 KB | 110 KB | Build projects; mini-builds + capstone; lab ideas; optional lessons (10–15); the 20-lessons-at-a-glance table |

Month 3 is the important one: the current file is a cut-down of this one and has no section
this archive lacks.

## What's in here

- `lesson-ideas/` — the three original MONTH_x_LESSON_IDEAS documents
- `research/` — the research notes that existed only in the curriculum repo
- `kanban-templates/` — that repo's PLAN/PROMPT/VIP templates and asset contract
- `skills/vip-intake.md` — the retired `/vip-intake` skill (queried Qdrant in 1_gwthpipeline520)
- `ORIGINAL_REPO_README.md` — the curriculum repo's own README, for provenance

## Where current work happens

Lesson ideas, research and syllabus now live in **this repo**, in `gwth_lesson_ideas/`.
That is a change from the rule written on 2026-04-23, which sent curriculum editing to a
separate repo. In practice the edits happened here anyway (2026-07-03), while the separate
repo went untouched from 2026-04-23, so the rule was pointing agents at stale files.
